shots.line: A streak of light over the park.
shots.note: night park under starry sky and crescent moon; a bright Taurid meteor streaks across the sky as Pip looks up from the lamp-lit path
looking up at Pip against the starry sky and park lamp; his eyes glint golden-cyan as he reaches up toward the falling streak
power word Catch: the slow-motion glowing meteor streak freezes right in Pip's open palm with concentric starlight rings
Pip's face lit warm gold from below by the captured star cupped in his mittens; soft heat wisps rise as he smiles
over Pip's blurred dark shoulder: Mo by the park bench with eyes squeezed shut and hands clasped, making a wish
Pip hands the glowing star into Mo's cupped palms; Mo's eyes pop wide open in amazed shock as the starlight lights both faces
top-down on the wooden park bench at 00:00 on Pip's phone; Pip's hand drops another glowing star into a glass mason jar
the glass jar packed with captured stars pulsing with intense, uncanny golden-white light; Pip and Mo exchange an uneasy look

shots.line: What if you could catch shooting stars?
shots.note: WHAT IF YOU / COULD CATCH A STAR? over the night park; Pip holds the glowing jar while freezing a slow-mo streak in his palm
One catch: the glow on Pip's face turns ominous crimson-orange and a hairline crack snaps across the glowing jar

shots.line: Taurid meteors hit the air at about
shots.note: blueprint schematic of Earth's upper atmosphere (100 KM) with a Southern Taurid meteoroid slamming into the air and compressing plasma
velocity schematic counting up to 27 KM/S (97,200 KM/H) with ram-pressure shockwave vectors lighting up orange-red
speed comparison: RIFLE BULLET (~1 KM/S) vs TAURID METEOR (27 KM/S) blazing past with an OVER 25X FASTER badge
a hyper-velocity glowing Taurid rock wrapped in a scorching red shockwave cone tearing straight toward Pip's outstretched hand
That's real: Pip and Mo look up in dread as harsh crimson fireball light floods down over their faces
a colossal Taurid fireball bolide splits the night clouds above the park, casting fierce red light over Pip and Mo below
the giant fireball hurtles toward Pip and Mo in the park below; IFMOSPHERE and Comment your what-if end card
